notes: Two small regime-balance adds: equities only on confirmed strength above three sixty, plus an inflation-protected bond to offset the existing deflation-leaning treasury bet; rest stays in cash.

rule_cited: Four Quadrants (growth-rising, inflation-falling bucket) + Markets discount the future, not the present
teach: Wait for the market to confirm a turn with price action, rather than guessing where the bottom is.
why: Stocks already dropped six percent this month, so I only buy if price proves a turn above three hundred sixty.

rule_cited: Four Quadrants (inflation-rising, growth-falling hedge) + Diversification is the holy grail
teach: A balanced portfolio holds something for every economic season, not just the one you expect.
why: I already own a bet that favors falling growth and falling prices, so I add an inflation hedge to balance it.
